title: selectionMetrics
description: Aggregates width, height, stroke, and corner radii across a multi-selection for the plugin UI, including mixed-value flags.

params.name: selection
params.description: Readonly array of currently selected SceneNodes.

returns.description: Metrics payload: hasSelection, items[], width, height, radius, rIndividual, strokeWeight, constrainProportions. Numeric fields may be the string 'mixed'.
